# Python OOP & Testing Practice

This repository was created to strengthen my understanding of Python **Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)** through practical, hands-on exercises. Additionally, I incorporated **pytest** to gain experience writing and running unit tests in a structured Python project.

---

## 📌 Overview

The project consists of **30 OOP exercises** designed to build and reinforce key concepts, ranging from class fundamentals to advanced patterns. 

* **Question Source:** Questions were generated by Claude to cover a comprehensive spectrum of OOP topics.
* **Status:** All 30 exercises are fully solved. Test suites for the solutions are currently work in progress.

---

## 📁 Repository Structure

The exercises are split into three difficulty levels across dedicated directories:

```text
.
├── beginner/                   # Exercises 1–10: Fundamentals (Classes, Attributes, Basic Methods)
├── intermediate/               # Exercises 11–20: Core Concepts (Inheritance, Polymorphism, Encapsulation)
├── hard/                       # Exercises 21–30: Advanced Concepts (Decorators, Dunder Methods, Metaclasses)
├── tests/                      # Pytest test cases (In Progress)
└── python_oop_challenges.md
└── README.md
